note: Which words to pick out in the examples of word-order topics.
why: The build derives highlights from a topic's own exercise answers, which works wherever the answer is a form. Word-order topics answer with a whole sentence, so 114 of their examples came out unmarked — and the thing being taught in them is a POSITION, which no list of forms can point at. These are written by hand, one example at a time, because the alternative was a parser guessing which word is the finite verb, and a wrong guess there teaches wrong grammar.
syntax: A mark is the word to highlight. Where a word occurs more than once in the same sentence, 'word[2]' picks the second. The build fails if a mark is not found, so a typo cannot pass silently.
